agent_role: Agent B - Experiment and Claim Auditor

experiments.name: 변수 관계 탐색 방법 비교
experiments.research_question: Do META, STAT, and upstream-aligned GDN contribute distinct and useful candidate relations under one frozen universe and budget?
experiments.comparison: META versus STAT versus GDN at the common top-20 budget, followed by contribution and stability analysis
experiments.dataset_scope: HAI 23.05 P1 normal-only discovery; current outputs use the frozen 144-pair universe
experiments.current_evidence: All three discovery arms executed and were audited; each produced a top-20 list and the unscored union contains 47 pairs, including 18 GDN-only candidates. This establishes candidate diversity, not unique useful contribution.
experiments.result_scope: Discovery-arm and union artifacts exist; the comparative scientific contribution experiment has not been performed.
experiments.primary_metrics: Seed and split stability; unique confirmed-relation contribution; downstream executable-rule yield; edge and source masking functional analysis
experiments.limitations: No isolated ablation establishes whether GDN-only candidates are stable, physically meaningful, or downstream-useful. GDN outputs are candidate evidence and not causal graphs.
experiments.next_action: Preregister the contribution comparison with fixed seeds, splits, masks, and downstream confirmation outcomes before execution.
experiments.claim_impact: GDN implementation and candidate diversity are supportable; GDN unique scientific benefit is unvalidated.

experiments.name: 규칙 수치 기준 비교
experiments.research_question: How do frozen relation-rule numeric criteria for response time or lag, tolerance, and persistence affect validity and utility?
experiments.comparison: Alternative preregistered relation-rule numeric criteria; D0 PCA threshold tuning is explicitly outside this experiment
experiments.dataset_scope: Normal-only P1 profiling and calibration authorities, with any later utility evaluation separately authorized
experiments.current_evidence: Normal-only numeric authority and frozen reference bindings are implemented, materialized, and audited for the current COMMON-42 runtime. Formal comparative sensitivity validation is incomplete.
experiments.result_scope: Current numeric references support deterministic execution; they do not establish optimal numeric criteria.
experiments.primary_metrics: Validity retention; abstention and firing behavior; normal false-alarm burden; attack-event response under separately frozen evaluation
experiments.limitations: Current fit, confirmation, lag, tolerance, and persistence choices are mostly preregistered but sensitivity remains untested. Labels must not select numeric authority.
experiments.next_action: Design a new normal-data-only comparative protocol and freeze candidate criteria before any label-aware evaluation.
experiments.claim_impact: Numeric provenance and deterministic binding are supportable; optimality or superiority of the chosen criteria is not.

experiments.name: 검증 피드백 기반 규칙 생성 비교
experiments.research_question: Does bounded verifier feedback improve rule construction relative to deterministic, one-shot, and budget-matched independent-generation controls?
experiments.comparison: T0 versus T1 versus T1-B versus T2
experiments.current_evidence: T0, T1, and T1-B accepted 42 of 42 relations; T2 accepted 39 of 42. T2 performed zero revise, retrieve, follow-up, or recovery actions, so its feedback mechanism was not empirically exercised.
experiments.result_scope: One frozen construction cohort and provider realization; validity and cost observations only, not downstream utility.
experiments.primary_metrics: Accepted-relation yield; no-rule count; validity issue distribution; feedback actions and recoveries; provider-call cost; downstream rule quality under a future preregistered test
experiments.limitations: The current cohort does not contain an exercised feedback-recovery path. T2 did not outperform T1 or T1-B, and utility was not tested in the construction comparison.
experiments.next_action: If retained as a thesis hypothesis, preregister an independent cohort with repairable cases and measure activated feedback recovery against a budget-matched T1-B control.
experiments.claim_impact: The four construction paths were implemented and executed; agentic verifier-feedback advantage is not established by the current pilot.

experiments.name: 검증된 관계 규칙의 이상탐지 성능 비교
experiments.research_question: Can verified relational rules detect attack events while controlling normal false-alarm episodes, alone or combined with a detector?
experiments.comparison: D0 detector-only versus D1 verified Rule-only versus D2 detector-plus-Rule policies
experiments.dataset_scope: HAI 23.05 P1 INNER; 14 independent attack events; held-out OUTER outcome unavailable
experiments.current_evidence: Frozen audited INNER results exist for D0, D1, D2 V1, and D2 V2. D1 responded to 13 of 14 events but had high normal FAR; D2 V1 and V2 each responded to 11 of 14 and recovered none of the three D0-missed events.
experiments.result_scope: A single 14-event INNER pilot with integrity-audited frozen artifacts.
experiments.primary_metrics: Attack-event Recall and Normal FAR episodes per hour; D0-miss recovery is a secondary fusion metric
experiments.limitations: The event count is small; D1 normal FAR is high; D2 V1 and V2 do not establish improvement; there is no held-out result and PCA-SPE is a simple reference baseline.
experiments.next_action: After new preregistration, expand event evidence and include at least one stronger multivariate detector baseline before making performance claims.
experiments.claim_impact: Rule signal and D0-D1 event-level complementarity are pilot observations; operational Rule-only utility, fusion improvement, and generalization remain unsupported or unvalidated.

experiments.name: 규칙 설명의 일치성 검증
experiments.research_question: Does the explanation output faithfully and reproducibly represent the frozen rule, runtime trace, numeric provenance, and evaluated outcome without unsupported content?
experiments.comparison: Automated explanation conformance across PASS, FAIL, and abstain outcomes; human usefulness is a separate future question
experiments.dataset_scope: Synthetic and representative trace-grounded explanation artifacts; no human-expert evaluation
experiments.current_evidence: A deterministic explanation renderer and trace-binding checks are implemented and audited, with representative explanation records. A formal comprehensive explanation-consistency experiment has not been executed.
experiments.primary_metrics: Source and target match; direction and time-criterion match; numeric provenance; PASS, FAIL, and abstain consistency; outcome consistency; omission; unsupported number, variable, or causal claim; deterministic reproducibility
experiments.limitations: Representative automated artifacts do not establish complete faithfulness across the scientific corpus and do not evaluate human understanding or operational usefulness.
experiments.next_action: Preregister automated corpus-level faithfulness checks; add a human study only if the thesis scope requires a human-usefulness claim.
experiments.claim_impact: Trace-grounded deterministic rendering is an implementation fact; explanation faithfulness is conditional and human usefulness is unvalidated.

experiments.name: 실시간 LLM 활용 비교
experiments.research_question: Can a future live-LLM arm be compared as an independent detection path without receiving the fixed-rule arm's outcome or ground truth?
experiments.comparison: Future R0 fixed deterministic runtime versus a separately authorized R1 live-LLM mode under strict information separation
experiments.current_evidence: The current deployed fixed-rule runtime is LLM-free. No authority evidence establishes a current real-time LLM detection comparison.
experiments.primary_metrics: To be preregistered only after role, input, output, latency, cost, and leakage boundaries are frozen
experiments.limitations: R1 must not receive the R0 final alarm or normal decision, final violation or satisfied outcome, test labels, or ground-truth outcome; otherwise it is explanation generation rather than an independent detection comparison.
experiments.next_action: Keep conditional and outside the current core contribution unless the user separately approves a preregistered design.
experiments.claim_impact: No live-LLM detection benefit claim is supportable; LLM-free wording applies to the current fixed-rule runtime only.

claims.claim_text: The end-to-end HAI P1 INNER architecture has been implemented.
contradicting_evidence: Empirical validation is partial, OUTER has no scientific result, and fresh-machine portability is weak.
claims.allowed_wording: The pinned HAI P1 INNER architecture and its frozen execution paths were implemented.
claims.forbidden_wording: The thesis method is fully validated or generalized.
claims.validation_needed: Expanded independent evaluation remains required for scientific-performance and generalization claims.

claims.claim_text: Normal data can be processed into executable verified relational rules within the implemented pipeline.
contradicting_evidence: The evidence is for the frozen P1 delayed-response family and does not establish physical truth or general rule-family coverage.
claims.allowed_wording: The implemented pipeline transformed confirmed normal-data relation evidence into frozen executable rules under deterministic authority controls.
claims.forbidden_wording: The pipeline discovered physically true or causal rules.
claims.validation_needed: Broader datasets and rule families require separate preregistration and evaluation.

claims.claim_text: The deterministic verifier checks structural, evidence-bound, parameter, split, and execution-contract validity.
contradicting_evidence: Verifier acceptance is not scientific, causal, or deployment-safety proof.
claims.allowed_wording: The verifier deterministically checks the frozen structural, evidence, parameter, split, and operational contract.
claims.forbidden_wording: The verifier scientifically proves the rule valid or proves a causal relation.
claims.validation_needed: No additional validation is needed for the narrow implementation claim; scientific utility remains separate.

claims.claim_text: Fixed-rule runtime execution is LLM-free and deterministic given frozen rule, reference, and input authorities.
contradicting_evidence: This claim applies to the frozen fixed-rule runtime and does not characterize any future live-LLM mode.
claims.allowed_wording: Given frozen rule, numeric-reference, authorization, and input artifacts, the current rule runtime evaluates without an LLM and produces deterministic traces.
claims.forbidden_wording: All current or future research runtime modes are LLM-free.
claims.validation_needed: Fresh-machine reproduction is still needed for portability, not for the narrow code-path characterization.

claims.claim_text: GDN provides unique useful relations beyond META and STAT.
contradicting_evidence: Eighteen GDN-only top-20 union candidates show set uniqueness, but no isolated stability, confirmation, rule-yield, or utility study establishes useful unique contribution.
claims.allowed_wording: The frozen GDN arm contributed candidates not present in the META or STAT top-20 sets; their unique scientific usefulness remains unvalidated.
claims.forbidden_wording: GDN uniquely improves detection, finds causal relations, or is superior to META and STAT.
claims.validation_needed: Preregistered seed and split stability, isolated unique-confirmation yield, and edge or source masking ablations.

claims.claim_text: Agentic verifier feedback improves rule quality.
contradicting_evidence: T2 performed zero feedback actions and accepted 39 of 42 relations while T0, T1, and T1-B each accepted 42 of 42 in the current cohort.
claims.allowed_wording: The current pilot did not establish an advantage from verifier feedback, and the feedback mechanism was not empirically exercised.
claims.forbidden_wording: Agentic feedback improved rule quality or optimized performance.
claims.validation_needed: An independent, budget-matched, preregistered cohort containing repairable cases must exercise and measure actual feedback recoveries.

claims.claim_text: Verified Rule-only showed different attack-event responses from D0 in the current INNER pilot.
contradicting_evidence: The comparison covers only 14 INNER events and D1 has a high normal false-alarm burden.
claims.allowed_wording: In the current 14-event INNER pilot, D1 responded to three events missed by D0 and D0 responded to one event missed by D1.
claims.forbidden_wording: Rule-only generally complements or outperforms the detector.
claims.validation_needed: Independent expanded-event and held-out evaluation with frozen metrics.

contradicting_evidence: D1 normal FAR was approximately 40.5026 episodes per hour in the 14-event INNER pilot, so the current configuration does not support operational deployment.
claims.allowed_wording: Rule-only produced high event sensitivity and high normal false-alarm burden in the current INNER pilot; practical utility remains unvalidated.
claims.forbidden_wording: Rule-only is operationally deployable or practically useful as is.
claims.validation_needed: A separately preregistered operational evaluation with acceptable false-alarm criteria, expanded events, and held-out evidence.

claims.claim_text: Detector plus Rule improves detection performance.
contradicting_evidence: D2 V1 and D2 V2 each matched D0's 11 of 14 event response, recovered zero of three D0 misses, and added normal false-alarm cost in the current INNER pilot.
claims.allowed_wording: The two frozen D2 policies did not improve D0 attack-event recall in the current INNER pilot.
claims.forbidden_wording: Detector-plus-Rule improves detection, or fusion can never work.
claims.validation_needed: Any broader fusion claim requires a new preregistered policy and independent data; current INNER tuning is closed.

contradicting_evidence: The authorized OUTER attempt stopped at feature-custody access before byte reads, parsing, model execution, predictions, labels, or metrics; no scientific outcome exists.
claims.allowed_wording: Held-out generalization remains unconfirmed because no OUTER scientific result is available.
claims.forbidden_wording: The method generalizes to held-out attacks, or OUTER performance failed.
claims.validation_needed: A newly authorized and preregistered held-out study with valid custody and no reuse of the consumed attempt.

claims.claim_text: The explanation faithfully reproduces frozen rule and runtime-trace information.
contradicting_evidence: Representative deterministic grounding checks exist, but no comprehensive corpus-level omission and faithfulness evaluation is frozen.
claims.allowed_wording: The renderer is deterministically bound to the accepted rule, verifier result, numeric references, runtime trace, and input window in the implemented contract.
claims.forbidden_wording: All generated explanations are scientifically faithful, complete, or useful to humans.
claims.validation_needed: Execute a preregistered automated faithfulness audit across all relevant outcomes and error classes.

claims.claim_text: The explanation improves human understanding or operations.
contradicting_evidence: No human-expert usefulness evaluation has been performed.
claims.allowed_wording: A trace-grounded explanation interface is implemented; human usefulness has not been evaluated.
claims.forbidden_wording: The explanations improve understanding, diagnosis, trust, or operations.
claims.validation_needed: A separate human-subject or expert evaluation if this claim becomes thesis-essential.

claims.claim_text: The discovered relations are causal or root-cause relationships.
contradicting_evidence: Discovery artifacts explicitly limit outputs to candidate or statistical evidence, and explanation contracts prohibit causal and root-cause claims.
claims.allowed_wording: The system records bounded temporal relation evidence and trace-grounded rule violations without causal attribution.
claims.forbidden_wording: The graph identifies causes, causal relations, or root causes.
claims.validation_needed: Causal claims would require a separate causal design and evidence authority not present in the current project.

mismatches.finding: Professor-facing wording that says rule-signal complementarity was confirmed can be read as broader validation.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: State that D0-D1 complementarity was observed only in the frozen 14-event INNER pilot.

mismatches.finding: A completed and audited GDN discovery arm plus 18 GDN-only top-20 union candidates does not establish unique stable or useful scientific contribution.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: Separate executed candidate diversity from the unperformed EXP-01 contribution validation.

mismatches.finding: The T2 arm is structurally a verifier-feedback controller, but the current cohort exercised zero feedback actions and provides no agentic-advantage evidence.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: Do not describe current Rule-only utility or construction success as an Agentic benefit.

mismatches.finding: D1 responded to 13 of 14 events but its normal FAR was approximately 40.5026 episodes per hour.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: Present sensitivity and false-alarm burden together; do not call Rule-only operationally useful.

mismatches.finding: Current D2 V1 and V2 results support a negative finding only for two frozen policies on the INNER pilot, not for fusion in general.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: Use policy-specific, INNER-scoped wording and prohibit both improvement and universal-impossibility claims.

mismatches.finding: The old OUTER path has no scientific performance outcome; it stopped at custody access before feature bytes, semantic parsing, labels, predictions, or metrics.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: Record OUTER as unavailable and generalization as unconfirmed, not as failed performance.

mismatches.finding: The term validity can be misread as scientific truth, causality, or deployment safety, while the verifier checks deterministic contract admissibility.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: Always qualify validity as structural, evidence-bound, parameter, split, and operational-contract validity.

mismatches.finding: A completed deterministic explanation renderer and representative grounding artifacts do not establish human usefulness or full-corpus faithfulness.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: Separate renderer implementation from EXP-05 faithfulness validation and human evaluation.

mismatches.finding: LLM-free runtime is true for the current frozen fixed-rule execution path but cannot be generalized to the conditional future live-LLM comparison.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: Scope LLM-free wording to the current D1 fixed-rule runtime.

mismatches.finding: Frozen result integrity and traceability are strong, but fresh-machine portability remains weak; audited artifacts are not equivalent to an independent fresh-machine reproduction.
mismatches.required_rcc_treatment: Keep reproduced and fresh-machine portable statuses distinct.

coordinator_notes: EXP-01, EXP-02, and EXP-05 classify the comparative experiment as not executed even though their supporting components and artifacts exist.
EXP-03 and EXP-04 classify the existing outcomes as audited pilots, not validated or generalized findings.
EXP-06 is conditional and future; no current live-LLM detection outcome exists.
CLAIM-F and CLAIM-I use NOT_SUPPORTED for the affirmative improvement propositions; the broader research questions may still be tested only under new preregistration.
CLAIM-K uses CONDITIONAL because structural trace grounding is implemented but comprehensive explanation-faithfulness evaluation is incomplete.

The current contribution should remain centered on graph-guided rule construction and deterministic verification, with Rule-only utility treated as a professor-prioritized but unresolved scientific question.
